name: Feature Request

title: "[FEATURE] Short and Clear Title"
labels: enhancement

---

## Feature Description
What feature would you like to see? Describe it briefly and clearly.

## Why It’s Needed
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve or what does it improve?

## Example Usage
How could this feature be used? Provide a scenario:
- For example, I’d do this...
- Then it would work like that...

## Alternative Solutions
If this isn’t possible, what other solutions might work?

## Additional Notes
Anything else you’d like to add? Write it here.
